defect: The cached cast vectors are created once per layout column, but ScanAtIndex and Gather index them by position in column_ids, so a scan over a column subset pairs columns with the wrong (or a wrongly typed) cast vector now that the cache is enabled.
reason: The fix builds the cache vectors over column_ids instead of all layout types and restores the column_ids loop bound, which is exactly the initialization this change added.

defect: The change disables reuse of the cached cast vector (if (false)); the fix only re-enables the cache after its initialization was fixed elsewhere.
reason: Falling back to a temporary cast vector is correct, only slower, so the fix restores an optimization rather than repairing a defect.

defect: column.attr("__getitem__") is bound before a pandas Series is replaced by its __array__, so rows are fetched with label-based Series indexing whose keys need not start at 0.
reason: The fix moves the __getitem__ lookup after the Series-to-array replacement, repairing the ordering this change introduced.

defect: The rewritten loop skips extensions whose drop_database is set (continue on != nullptr) and calls drop_database on extensions where it is null.
reason: The fix flips the condition to == nullptr, repairing the inverted check written in this change.

defect: No defect: the fix continues the clang-tidy cleanup (const LogicalType& parameters, dropping a move of a const reference).
reason: The change's by-value-plus-move constructors and const-ref SetValue are correct, and the fix only alters parameter passing style.

defect: No defect: the fix renames the camelCase parameters vectorType/logicalType to snake_case.
reason: A pure naming/style change.

defect: No defect: the fix changes the Vector constructors to take const LogicalType& instead of by value.
reason: Making the constructors explicit is correct and the fix only changes parameter passing style.

defect: The new MapUtil::ReinterpretMap marks the result with the input's vector type and copies its buffer, which corrupts dictionary inputs; map_entries, which this change switched from Reinterpret (correct for dictionaries) to this helper, now breaks on dictionary vectors.
reason: The fix slices by the input selection and sets the vector type last in the helper this change added; the same flaw already existed in the map_from_entries code it was moved from, but the map_entries regression is new.

defect: The fix repairs a performance regression by giving HugeIntCastData a native INTERMEDIATE_T, after a later commit had changed the intermediates to ResultType.
reason: This change kept int64_t intermediates, and a performance regression introduced by a later commit is not a defect of this change.

defect: The fix re-adds InitializeParquetReader for the initial and union readers in InitGlobal and replaces the constant-state struct; that initialization had been removed by the preceding commit 44b7f9b.
reason: This change only copied the file list and passed the filter pointer directly, both of which the fix keeps.

defect: The fix (#3480) moves enum category conversion out of NumpyResultConversion::Append so that empty results still get categories.
reason: Categories were filled only inside Append before this change too, so the empty-result bug was pre-existing; the change's own py::cast line was removed earlier.

defect: The new header includes the CMake-generated generated_extension_headers.hpp without excluding DUCKDB_AMALGAMATION, so the amalgamation script cannot resolve the include and the amalgamation build fails.
reason: The same-day fix adds !defined(DUCKDB_AMALGAMATION) to the guard this change added and skips that header in amalgamation.py.

defect: The fix forces a single global hash table for DISTINCT aggregates in the later radix-partitioned parallel aggregate.
reason: This change used one global HT under a lock, so distinct aggregates were correct; the bug came with the later parallel hash tables.

defect: The new check throws for dictionary pages with num_values == 0, rejecting valid Parquet files with empty dictionaries.
reason: The same-day fix relaxes the check to num_values < 0 and moves the empty-dictionary error to the point where offsets are actually read.

defect: The fix extends the missing-dictionary check in Offsets to also reject an empty dictionary (dict->len == 0).
reason: The change's !dict check is correct; reading offsets from an empty dictionary was unguarded before and after it, so the fix closes a pre-existing gap.

defect: EncodeData<int32_t>(dataptr, value.micros, ...) truncates the int64_t micros field that template deduction previously encoded as int64_t.
reason: The fix changes the explicit template argument for micros to int64_t, undoing the truncation this change introduced.

defect: The new SetQuote silently ignores an empty quote string, where the previous code set quote='' and has_quote, so QUOTE '' no longer disables quoting.
reason: The fix removes the early return for an empty quote that this change added.

defect: The fix changes the include from zstd/dict/zdict.h to zdict.h after a merged vendored-zstd update moved the header.
reason: At this change the header existed at third_party/zstd/include/zstd/dict/zdict.h and its sources were compiled, so the include was correct; the breakage came from the merge.

defect: The new constructor SampleOptions(int64_t seed = -1) casts -1 to idx_t and initializes the optional_idx seed with INVALID_INDEX, which throws, so every default-constructed SampleOptions fails.
reason: The same-day fix renames the parameter and only sets the seed when seed_ >= 0, repairing the constructor this change declared and defined.

defect: SampleOptions::Deserialize reads an int64_t seed directly into the optional_idx member (ReadPropertyWithDefault<int64_t>(..., result->seed)), which does not compile.
reason: The same-day fix reads the seed into a local and passes it to the constructor, replacing the deserializer this change added.

defect: CreateProjectionReference assigns expr.alias only when it is empty (inverted condition), so the bound column reference never gets the expression's alias.
reason: The fix changes the condition to !expr.alias.empty(), correcting the inversion written in this change.

defect: The fix changes how the ADBC test sets the temporary-ingest option (ADBC_OPTION_VALUE_ENABLED plus the target table name).
reason: Both change and fix touch only test code, and the fix adjusts the test's option usage rather than repairing a product defect.

defect: The fix flips the top bit of the stored UUID so that ORDER BY uuid matches varchar order, and rewrites ToString accordingly.
reason: The ordering mismatch comes from the signed hugeint representation that predates this printf-format change, which itself formats correctly.

defect: The fix removes the UUID-to-HUGEINT cast that the change added for debugging ORDER BY.
reason: The added cast worked as written; removing a debug convenience alongside the representation change is cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The new branch-free Subtract mishandles wrap-around when (value - tuple_idx) is a multiple of the block size, leaving tuple_idx equal to the divisor and block_idx one too low.
reason: The fix replaces the arithmetic this change introduced with a RandomAccess on the absolute index, as the pre-change code did.

defect: The fix flattens the arguments, stops applying the child selection before slicing, and uses the child offset rather than a running counter as payload.
reason: Applying the child selection before slicing and the running payload counter both predate this change, which only moved where the selection was applied.

defect: Merge executes the first filter directly into the result and then ANDs in place, which can modify a referenced input column; the fix evaluates into a temporary and copies.
reason: The same Execute-then-Merge-in-place pattern already existed in PhysicalFilter before this change, which only moved it into ExpressionExecutor::Merge.

defect: GetJoinSide resolves correlated columns of depth > 1 against the current join's bindings; the fix returns BOTH for them.
reason: This file was moved verbatim from logical_plan_generator.cpp, where the same loop over correlated_columns already existed.

defect: MERGE INTO assumes the plan root is the join and indexes root->children; the fix walks down single-child operators (e.g. a filter from a parenthesized condition) to the join.
reason: The assumption that the root is the join predates this change, which only chose the child index by join inversion.

defect: increment * current_idx and the remaining-count computation run in unsigned idx_t arithmetic, so negative increments produce wrong current values and huge remaining counts.
reason: The same-day fix makes current_value int64_t and the min<> signed, repairing the arithmetic this new function introduced.

defect: The align lambda is used only inside D_ASSERT, which compiles away in release builds, leaving an unused local variable that breaks warnings-as-errors builds.
reason: The next-day fix for the platform-specific release build failure replaces exactly this lambda with a static helper function.

defect: The fix (#4574) stops the parallel scan loop at empty row groups to avoid an assertion with verify_parallelism on empty tables.
reason: The change's max_row == 0 guard was later rewritten, and the empty-row-group assertion under verify_parallelism is not caused by it.

defect: ScheduleOperator schedules each parallel scan task while still counting and sets total_tasks only afterwards (starting from 1), so an early-finishing task can finish the pipeline before all tasks exist, or finish it twice.
reason: The next-day race-condition fix gathers all tasks first, sets total_tasks, and only then schedules them, repairing the scheduling this change added.

defect: The union-pipeline dependency is now added only when the sink is order-preserving without batch indices, dropping the global insertion-order condition, so order-dependent operators in the current pipeline lose UNION ALL order.
reason: The fix adds current.IsOrderDependent() to the condition this change narrowed.

defect: The fix adds an order_matters parameter to the CreateUnionPipeline declaration to support a logic fix in physical_union.cpp and meta_pipeline.cpp.
reason: The header declaration in this initial MetaPipeline commit is not defective; the order bug lies in later implementation code.

defect: The fix adds a null check on source in Pipeline::IsOrderDependent.
reason: The unguarded source dereference predates this change, which only added a sink null check; it became reachable only through the fix's own new call on a pipeline without a source.

defect: The re-enabled macOS block tests flags & FileFlags::FILE_FLAGS_DIRECT_IO, but FileOpenFlags has no operator&, so the file does not compile on macOS.
reason: The same-day fix for the macOS error replaces the expression with flags.DirectIO() in the block this change uncommented.

defect: The fix removes unused local named_parameters maps from PragmaStatement.
reason: The unused locals are dead code; the real named-parameter fix is in pragma_handler.cpp.

defect: The fix makes BindNamedParameters a public static method so that PragmaHandler can call it.
reason: This change only switched the private declaration to reference parameters, which is not a defect; the fix is an interface extension for a new caller.

defect: The fix makes HandlePragma check and cast named parameters with Binder::BindNamedParameters before calling the pragma query.
reason: Pragmas had no named parameters when this file was written; validating them belongs to the later named-parameter feature (8acaf4b).
